source_caption:
Phoebe Waller-Bridge uses her fourth-wall breaks as a coping mechanism, a defense shield to keep both the world and the audience at a safe distance. But when Andrew Scott’s character notices her slipping away into the camera, the entire structure of the show shifts.

By having someone catch her mid-gaze, the series pivots from comedy to raw emotional vulnerability. Supported by Waller-Bridge’s brilliant writing and perfect 100% critic scores on Rotten Tomatoes, Fleabag swept the Emmy Awards including Outstanding Comedy Series because it captured a simple, tragic truth: true intimacy isn't just being loved, it's being caught.

H/t ~ @soulcinema_
